headline: Iraq to Cut Fuel Subsidies from September | Iraq Business News
summary: Iraq's Cabinet approved measures to reform crude oil pricing and reduce fuel subsidies, effective from September 1, 2026, with crude purchases priced at SOMO rates or the budget price.
why: Fuel subsidy reform changes domestic energy prices and government spending, and affects Iraq's crude sales through the State Oil Marketing Organization.
